shortDescription: Manage Mac App Store applications with mas-cli

options.name: id
options.description: The Mac App Store identifier of the app(s) you want to manage. This can be found by running C(mas search APP_NAME) on your machine.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the app installation. The V(absent) value requires root permissions, also see the examples.

options.name: upgrade_all
options.description: Upgrade all installed Mac App Store apps.
